correctness.rationale: For every unequal positive a,b, the two radical parameters are strictly positive and satisfy the two displayed polynomial identities. Those identities give exactly the inverse diagonal and cross entries, hence support equalities at all facet normals. The Schur complement is positive and explicit strictly positive John weights reproduce both contact moment identities, proving global maximum volume and uniqueness; eigenvalues and volume follow from the two block-mean eigenvalues. Finite checks in the actual package verify 169 numeric cases, 10647 tangencies, and 12 exact-rational star cases with 168 contacts; their non-exhaustiveness is explicit.

value.rationale: Unequal rank sizes are the natural independent parameters of complete height-two posets and are prominent in the source literature; the balanced problem cannot represent them. The result obtains an exact unique center, complete four-orbit squared-semiaxis spectrum, exact volume, and simultaneous tangency at every facet across the entire unequal two-parameter family. The cross-block inverse and three strictly positive facet-weight families supply structural content beyond direct balanced substitution or a small numerical table. It serves as a fully solved canonical metric example for chain/order polytopes.
